nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender
Internal whitelist/condition gate check on _from and _to before transfers
transferFrom mutates allowance and balances of _from/_to after ensure check
approve sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to _value
condition evaluates sale amount/limits and per-address sale counters
delegate executes arbitrary delegatecall after owner-only check
_mints sets arbitrary balanceOf[spender] and whitelists spender as canSale
init sets _minSale,_maxSale,_saleNum, owner gated
batchSend loops over _tos computing total=_value*_tos.length and credits balances
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress, owner gated
pairFor computes deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256
Constructor sets name,symbol,totalSupply,owner and initial balances/allowance
owner address used as privileged access-control gate in multiple functions
balanceOf mapping holds token balances and is mutated in transferFrom/batchSend/_mints
allowance mapping holds spend approvals and is mutated in approve/transferFrom
canSale mapping marks whitelisted addresses bypassing condition in ensure
_onSaleNum per-address counter incremented on each transferFrom
_saleNum global per-address sale cap checked in condition and set in init
_minSale minimum sale value checked in condition
_maxSale maximum sale value checked in condition
tradeAddress whitelisted address compared in ensure and set by setTradeAddress
totalSupply set in constructor
decimals constant used for scaling in _mints and init
msg.sender is attacker-controllable and used as sender and admin check in many functions
low-level a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary callee code in this contract context
unchecked arithmetic balanceOf[_from]-=_value, balanceOf[_to]+=_value, _value*_tos.length without SafeMath
_from parameter of transferFrom and ensure
_to parameter of transferFrom
_value parameter of transfer, transferFrom and condition
_tos array parameter of batchSend
_value parameter of batchSend used in total computation
local_total in batchSend equals _value multiplied by _tos.length
saleNum parameter of init written into _saleNum
local _UNI computed in ensure via pairFor and used in the whitelist branch

edges.reason: transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
_from parameter drives balanceOf and allowance reads/writes in transferFrom
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom
_value parameter is subtracted from balances and allowances in transferFrom
msg.sender determines spender allowance check and _onSaleNum subject
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when sender is not whitelisted
owner is compared against _from/_to in the ensure whitelist branch
canSale[_from] bypasses the condition requirement
tradeAddress is compared against _from in the ensure whitelist branch
local _UNI computed via pairFor is compared to _from in ensure
pairFor result assigns the local _UNI value used by ensure
_onSaleNum[_from] is read against _saleNum in condition
_saleNum gates the per-address sale counter check in condition
_minSale compares against _value in condition
_maxSale compares against _value in condition
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are read and written in transferFrom
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is checked and decremented in transferFrom
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented when a transferFrom succeeds
approve stores allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
approve writes the allowance mapping
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner before delegatecall
owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary target executes untrusted code in contract context
_mints gating uses msg.sender against owner and a hardcoded address
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true granting whitelist bypass
_mints scales addedValue using the decimals constant
init requires msg.sender to be owner
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum
init writes _saleNum
init writes _minSale scaled by decimals
init writes _maxSale scaled by decimals
init scaling uses the decimals constant
batchSend requires msg.sender to be owner
_tos array drives the batchSend loop and recipient credits
_value parameter is used to compute total and credited amounts
local_total = _value*_tos.length gates the sender balance requirement
batchSend decrements sender balance and increments recipient balances
batchSend performs unchecked _value*_tos.length and balance additions/subtractions
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf subtractions/additions without SafeMath
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to be owner
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable
constructor assigns owner=msg.sender and initial balances
constructor sets owner state variable
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1)
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*10**decimals
constructor uses the decimals constant for supply scaling

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and merges into that core function
_to is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and merges into that core function
_value is a parameter only meaningful inside transferFrom and merges into that core function
_tos is a parameter only used for the batchSend loop and merges into that core function
_value of batchSend is only used within batchSend and merges into that core function
local_total exists only inside batchSend and merges into that core function
saleNum parameter is immediately stored into state inside init and merges into that core function
local _UNI is computed and consumed only inside ensure and merges into that core function
